notes: Set types: mark a set as a warm-up, a drop set or taken to failure — a warm-up is no longer counted as a working set or adds tonnage, and drop and failure sets count for more effort.
Body measurements: log waist, chest and arm alongside your weight in the same bodyweight log, see each as a trend, and they travel with your export.

Accessibility: the dialog now traps Tab, closes on Escape and returns focus to whatever opened it; the consistency grid's cells read out their date and sets; and the smallest labels are easier to read.
